COMMANDS
    caramelo context              Say where this CLI is running and what a command typed here would act on
    caramelo fleet                Manage the fleets this commander talks to
      caramelo fleet setup        Turn this machine into a Caramelo host (run as root)
    caramelo manual               The manual of this machine: every command that holds here, with examples
    caramelo member               Inspect this machine, and the fleet it is part of
      caramelo member join        Join this machine to a hub (run on the machine, as root)
    caramelo peer                 Manage the identities allowed on the machine's network
      caramelo peer add           Admit an identity by its WireGuard public key
      caramelo peer list          List the identities on the machine's network
    caramelo status               Show whether caramelod and Docker are up, and how we reached them
    caramelo version              Print the caramelo version
